senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of next w.) to sing.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 14b:10">Ber. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>ושַׁרְנוּ לך</he> and we sang (praises) unto thee.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91b:14">Snh. 91ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 15:1">Ex. XV, 1</cite>) <he>שָׁר לא נאמר אלא יָשִׁיר</he> it does not read, ‘he sang’; but, ‘he shall sing’; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 1; a. e.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:6">Num. R. s. 3</cite> (play on <he>ב̇כ̇וש̇ר̇ות</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 68:7">Ps. LXVIII, 7</cite>) <he>אותן שהיו ב̇וכ̇ין … מְ֗ש̇ו̇רְ֗רִין עכשיו</he> those who formerly wept …, were now singing.
<cite ref="Psalms 68:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ועבד מְשׁוֹרֵר וכ׳</he> and the slave sings, because he is relieved &c.
B. Bath. 120ᵃ מְשׁוֹרְרִים לפניה went singing (bridal songs) before her; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVI באין ושוררין, read: ושׁוֹרִין, v. שָׁרָה II.]—מְשׁוֹרֵר singer, esp. Temple singer (Levite).

<cite ref="Arakhin 11b:14">Arakh. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ששיער ומשוער ששורר</he> if one designated as a singer acts as gate-guard, or a gate-guard acts as singer; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְשׁוֹרְרִים</he>, <he>מְשׁוֹרְרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Arakhin 11b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>שאתה מן המ׳ וכ׳</he> for thou belongest to the singers, and not to the gate-guards; a. fr.
